title: Closing credits

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Make credits readable as a separate closing unit so contributors can be identified without competing imagery.
strategic_value: A consistent color-backed credits treatment can give Helsinki productions a clear and orderly ending.
demonstration: This expanded webpage-section capture places a centered blue credits specimen beside guidance on background, alignment and Regular/Bold role separation.
practical_value: Separate titles and names by font weight and use a color background for the credits.

content_islands.spec: Place the blue field with centered white lines at left.

content_islands.name: Role and spacing notes
content_islands.spec: Place the legibility reason, weight separation and template dimensions alongside.

ingredient.name: Closing credits
ingredient.application: Use a color background and centered text with Regular/Bold role separation.
ingredient.scope: Closing credits; adjacent template uses 100 px text and 120 px line spacing, centered in both directions.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text explicitly requires a color background for legibility.

reference_purposes.Constraint: Closing credits are always placed on a color background and centered horizontally.
